messages.text: Looked up for Sarah: H15 Dual isn't buyable yet — drop date unannounced, $999, ships mid-November. Harlo B30 at $899, ~30 TH/s, is the one she can sell today.

Hey, I'm Sarah! I know every miner we carry, and I'm here to help. Under twelve cents, that's a good rate for mining. Give me a second and I'll run the Harlo H15 Dual — Bitcoin + Dogecoin at that price. Roughly what do you pay, ten, eleven? Tap an answer, or the mic and tell me.
So, hey, Sarah. Can you add the h fifteen to my cart?
Looked up for Sarah: H15 Dual can't be added — it's not on sale until the drop, date unannounced, ships mid-November. Offer the notify list, or the B30 at $899.
Looked up for Sarah: B30 is live at $899, ~30 TH/s, 360–450 W, about 50 dB — roughly $32 a month power at 10¢. Ships Nov 30.
